scripts.render:films: for f in SignIn Share Collect Prove Connect; do remotion render src/index.ts ${f}Wide out/film-$f-wide.mp4 --crf=23 && remotion render src/index.ts ${f}Tall out/film-$f-tall.mp4 --crf=23 || exit 1; done
scripts.render:short: remotion render src/index.ts ShortWide out/revoked-short-wide.mp4 --crf=23 && remotion render src/index.ts ShortTall out/revoked-short-tall.mp4 --crf=23
